prompt: A model predicting hospital readmission uses a column that is filled in after the patient was readmitted.
tells: filled in after the patient was readmitted
trap: The data isn't unfair; it's from the future.

prompt: Test accuracy is suspiciously perfect because the test rows were copies of training rows.
trap: The model may be fine; the test isn't.

prompt: A model predicting which customers will leave uses 'account closed date' as an input.
trap: It isn't the label; it's a leak of it.

prompt: A fraud model includes the investigator's final verdict among its inputs.
why: The verdict comes after the fact: leakage.
trap: Using it as an input, not a label, is the problem.

prompt: A stock model was trained with tomorrow's price accidentally included.
The data was scaled using statistics from all rows before splitting off the test set.
tells: before splitting off the test set
trap: The split happened, just too late.
